기능만큼 아름다움도 중요하다고 믿는 두 라이더가 만든 타이어, Ultra: Tires made by two riders who believe beauty matters as much as function. Ultradynamico.

Ultradynamico(울트라다이나미코)는 오랜 친구이자 스스로를 '타: Ultradynamico is an American tire brand made by two old friends and self-described tire fetishists, Ron (Ultraromance) and Pat (Ultratradition). To them the bicycle is where utility meets artistic design, so a tire's ride and its looks matter equally.
둘이 합쳐 50년 가까이 타이어를 들여다본 끝에, 요란한 로고와 이상한: After nearly fifty years of combined tread awareness, they had grown numb to garish logos, bizarre tread patterns and overbuilt, lifeless casings. Years of all-terrain riding, a passion for high-end rubber, an eye for design and a dash of third-grade science led them to make their own. The startup funds came from selling some long-forgotten stock.
카바, 브뤼, 로제, 마르스. 잔이 채워질수록 트레드가 깊어집니다: Cava, Brut, Rosé, Mars. The fuller the glass, the knobbier the tread
레이스, JFF, 로쪼, 로부스토. 같은 트레드, 다른 성격: Race, JFF, Rozzo, Robusto. Same tread, different character
네 가지 트레드와 네 가지 케이싱으로 만든 16가지 타이어: Sixteen tires from four treads and four casings
타이어 명가 파나레이서가 일본에서 생산: Made in Japan by the tire house Panaracer
Tires for the connoisseur.<br/>타이어를 아는 사:
Tires for the connoisseur.
For people who know their tires.
타이어는 자전거의 인상을 가장 크게 바꾸는 부품입니다. Ultradyna: Tires change the look of a bike more than any other part. Ultradynamico finishes a build with a soft amber skinwall, a quiet label and a geometric tread, and reads the road through a supple, high-TPI casing. Your bicycle is an extension of your personality, and your riding style a window into your soul.
모델 이름은 모두 와인에서 가져왔습니다. 카탈루냐의 스파클링 와인 카바,: Every model is named after a wine: Cava, the sparkling wine of Catalonia, Brut, the dry sparkling style, Rosé, and Mars, from Marsala, the fortified wine of Sicily. The names are playful. The tires are serious.
가장 매끈한 카바부터 노브가 깊은 마르스까지. 네 가지 트레드는 잔이 채: From the smoothest, Cava, to the knobbiest, Mars. The four treads deepen in order, like a glass being filled.
케이싱은 타이어의 뼈대이자 심장입니다. 승차감과 생동감, 개성이 모두 여: The casing is the skeleton and the heart of a tire. Ride quality, liveliness and personality all come from here.
사이드월의 색은 로트마다 조금씩 다릅니다. 와인처럼, 같은 이름 안에서도: The sidewall colour varies slightly from batch to batch. Like wine, the hue can change within the same name.
낮은 공기압으로 더 빠르고, 더 편하고, 더 잘 붙는 타이어. 튜블리스로: Faster, more comfortable and grippier at low pressure. Set them up tubeless to feel what they can do.
“처음엔 세상에 없던 타이어 하나를 만들고 싶었을 뿐입니다. 아무도 원하: “We only wanted to make one tire that didn't exist. Even if nobody else wanted them, the two of us would be set for life.”
론은 '울트라로맨스(Ultraromance)'라는 이름으로 더 잘 알려진: Ron is better known as Ultraromance, a rider who helped popularise relaxed bikepacking and adventure riding. His workshop is in a 300-year-old barn on a farm in the lower Connecticut River valley, and that barn is also where Ultradynamico tires are warehoused. Most of the other bike parts he designs are released through Crust Bikes.
팻은 '울트라트래디션(Ultratradition)'으로 불리는 론의 오랜: Pat, known as Ultratradition, is Ron's longtime friend. In the 2000s the two co-founded the road racing team Wooly Mammoth in Austin, Texas, and they have shared a fussy taste in tires ever since.
2018년 무렵 시작한 작업은 이듬해 첫 타이어 로제로 세상에 나왔습니다: Work began around 2018, and the first tire, Rosé, arrived the following year. They drew the treads and knobs from scratch, combining what they loved in their favourite tires with rider feedback, and production is handled by Panaracer in Japan.
잔이 채워질수록 트레드는 깊어집니다. 노면과 자전거에 맞는 한 가지를 고: The fuller the glass, the knobbier the tread. Pick the one that suits your roads and your bike.
슬릭에 가까운 3D 다이아몬드 파일 트레드. 빠른 그래블과 올로드, 70: A near-slick 3D diamond file tread. Fast gravel and all-road, and classic road in 700C x 33.
촘촘한 마이크로 트라이앵글. 포장도로에선 매끄럽고 흙길에선 카바보다 조금: Tightly spaced micro triangles. Smooth on pavement, with a little more bite in the dirt than Cava.
Ultradynamico의 첫 타이어이자 라인업의 중심. 연속 센터 트레: Ultradynamico's first tire and the mainstay of the range. Continuous center tread and delta knobs.
라이더가 디자인한 가장 깊은 트레드. 마르고 느슨한 코너와 싱글트랙을 위: The knobbiest tread, designed by riders. An ATB tire for loose, dry corners and singletrack.
The speed of a slick,
trust in the corners.
Like a fine Catalan Cava.
카바는 볼륨 큰 슬릭 타이어의 공짜 속도를 원하지만, 느슨한 코너에서는: Cava is a minimalist tread for riders who want the free speed of a high-volume slick but need a tire that is more predictable in loose corners. Its 3D diamond file tread massages granular terrain for a perceived 20 to 30% more traction than a slick.
중앙에 끊김 없이 이어지는 델타 패턴이 구름 저항을 줄이고, 진짜 슬릭보: A continuous center of delta shapes keeps rolling resistance low, and it is less prone to tread slashes than a true slick. It pairs well in the rear with a knobbier Rosé or Mars up front. The 700C x 33 is a road classics tire for the cobbles and short dirt sectors of Flanders, not a gravel tire.
잘게 나뉜 다이아몬드 패턴이 잔자갈을 부드럽게 눌러 잡습니다. 슬릭의 구: A finely divided diamond pattern gently grips loose gravel. The roll of a slick, with a perceived 20 to 30% more grip.
중앙에 이어지는 델타 패턴이 직진에서 속도를 지키고, 기울였을 때는 예측: A continuous line of deltas holds speed in a straight line and gives predictable grip when leaned over.
얇고 가볍고 아주 빠른 로드 클래식 타이어. 튜블리스 최대 60psi,: A thin, light and very fast road classics tire. Up to 60psi tubeless; above that, a latex tube is recommended.
700C 33·39·42부터 650B 47.99, 27.5인치와 26인치: From 700C 33, 39 and 42 to 650B 47.99, 27.5 and 26 inch. From road to classic MTB rebuilds.
빠른 그래블, 올로드, 로드 클래식(700C x 33): Fast gravel, all-road, road classics (700C x 33)
그레이 트레드 + 앰버 스킨월 (700C x 33 그린·블랙, 26인치: Grey tread and amber skinwall (green and black in 700C x 33, red in 26 inch, black for Robusto)
포장도로에선 매끄럽게,<br/>흙길에선 조금 더 깊게.<br/>카바와 로:
Smooth on pavement,
a little more bite in the dirt.
Between Cava and Rosé.
브뤼는 빠르고 마른 노면을 생각하며 만든 트레드로, 깊이는 카바와 로제의: Brut was dreamed up with fast, dry terrain in mind, and its tread depth lands between Cava and Rosé. The goal was a tire that rolls smoothly on pavement yet bites a little more than Cava in the dirt.
촘촘하게 배치한 마이크로 트라이앵글이 아스팔트 위에서는 반짝이듯 가볍게: Tightly spaced micro triangles sparkle on asphalt, and once tipped onto singletrack they give confident braking traction and grip. Tread rubber extends down the sidewall for a little added protection without spoiling the ride of the lightest, most supple Race casing. Brut means almost no sugar, yet this is a very sweet tire.
삼각형은 이 차원에서 가장 튼튼한 도형입니다. 작은 삼각형이 촘촘히 모여: The triangle is the strongest shape in this dimension. Small triangles packed tightly balance rolling speed and grip.
트레드 고무를 사이드월까지 연장해 돌과 가지에 쓸리는 부분을 조금 더 지: Tread rubber runs down the sidewall to guard the parts that rub against rocks and branches. Weight and suppleness barely change.
A single 29 inch size for drop-bar MTBs and big-tire gravel bikes. 580g in Race casing.
빠르고 마른 그래블, 투어링, 드롭바 MTB: Fast, dry gravel, touring, drop-bar MTB
마이크로 트라이앵글, 사이드월까지 연장된 트레드 고무: Micro triangles, tread rubber extended down the sidewall
The first tire,
the mainstay of the range.
Pavement and dirt alike.
로제는 Ultradynamico의 첫 타이어이자 지금도 라인업의 중심입니: Rosé was Ultradynamico's first tire and is still the mainstay of the range. It handles pavement and dirt like a skilled musician handles a Stradivarius. A near-continuous center tread drives you forward, and delta knobs deliver braking traction when you re-enter the gravel.
약 1,000km를 달리면 트레드 아래 숨어 있던 파일 패턴의 언더트레드: After about 1,000km, a file-pattern undertread hidden beneath the knobs is revealed. This tire actually gets faster with age. Run Rosé front and rear for maximum off-road traction, or swap the rear to Cava to drift the corners a little more.
중앙이 거의 이어져 있어 포장도로에서 구름이 매끄럽고, 페달링의 힘이 그: A near-continuous center rolls smoothly on pavement and turns your pedalling straight into forward motion.
삼각형 노브가 흙길과 자갈에서 제동 트랙션을 냅니다. 포장에서 비포장으로: Triangular knobs give braking traction on dirt and gravel. The moment you leave the pavement feels easy.
노브가 닳으면 아래의 파일 패턴이 드러납니다. 오래 탈수록 더 빨라지는: As the knobs wear, a file pattern appears beneath. That is why it gets faster the longer you ride it.
로제 둘로 오프로드 그립을, 뒤에 카바를 더해 코너의 경쾌함을. 앞뒤 조: Two Rosés for off-road grip, or a Cava in the rear for lively corners. The pairing changes the character.
앞은 로제, 뒤는 카바: Rosé up front, Cava in the rear
Ultradynamico tires are designed to pair with each other. Cava has slightly more volume than Rosé, giving it the same effective outside diameter, so running Rosé up front and Cava in the rear leaves the bike's geometry unchanged.
노브가 깊은 앞바퀴는 코너와 제동에서 방향을 잡고, 매끈한 뒷바퀴는 구름: The knobbier front tire steers through corners and braking, while the smoother rear reduces rolling resistance. For rougher roads choose two Rosés, for faster ones two Cavas.
연속 센터 트레드, 델타 노브, 파일 언더트레드: Continuous center tread, delta knobs, file undertread
Veer slightly off course,
and you end up
in a place like Mars.
마르스는 라이더가 직접 디자인하고 ATB 성능에 맞춰 다듬은, 라인업에서: Mars is the knobbiest tread in the range, designed by riders and tuned for ATB performance. A ramped, continuous center delta rolls fast when you pedal and brakes with confidence when you modulate.
사이드 노브는 마르고 느슨한 코너에서 자전거를 놓치지 않고, 넓은 노브: Side knobs won't let you down in loose, dry corners, and wide knob spacing sheds mud while leaving artistic patterns in the dust. The name comes from Marsala, the fortified wine of Sicily. With a 26 inch option, it suits classic MTB rebuilds too.
경사진 삼각형이 이어진 센터 라인. 굴릴 때는 가볍고, 제동할 때는 노면: A center line of ramped triangles. Light when rolling, and firmly gripping the ground when braking.
마르고 느슨한 코너에서 기울여도 자전거가 미끄러지지 않도록 바깥쪽 노브를: The outer knobs stand tall so the bike holds its line when leaned into loose, dry corners.
노브 사이를 넓혀 진흙이 잘 빠집니다. 레이스 케이싱에도 트레드 고무를: Wider gaps between knobs shed mud easily. Even the Race casing gets tread rubber extended down the sidewall for added protection.
램프드 센터 델타, 사이드 노브, 넓은 노브 간격: Ramped center delta, side knobs, wide knob spacing
The casing is the skeleton of a tire,
its heart and soul.
타이어의 승차감과 생동감, 그리고 개성은 케이싱에서 나옵니다. Ultra: A tire's ride quality, liveliness and personality all come from its casing. Ultradynamico makes every one of its four treads in four casings. From the lightest, most supple Race to the Robusto that handles anything, choose by your riding style and your roads.
가장 빠른 컴파운드에 사이드월 보호는 없습니다. 최고의 승차감 대신 펑크: The fastest compound with zero sidewall protection. The best ride quality, but no forgiveness for punctures. If you are an aggressive rider who punctures often, consider Rozzo.
가벼운 구조를 가장 합리적인 가격에 담은 데일리 타이어. 레이스보다 조금: An accessible everyday tire with lightweight construction at the best price. A slightly thicker casing than Race and a longer-wearing compound. Approachable luxury.
레이스 컴파운드에 비드 보강과 사이드월 보호를 더했습니다. 낮은 공기압에: Race compound with bead reinforcement and sidewall protection. Burp-free at low pressure. Run Race up front and Rozzo in the rear.
사이드월 보호에 조금 더 단단한 트레드 컴파운드를 더한 가장 튼튼한 케이: Sidewall protection with a slightly harder tread compound makes this the most durable casing. Good for loaded touring. Available only in the toughest colour imaginable: black.
앞바퀴는 가장 유연한 레이스로 손에 전해지는 승차감을: Up front, the supple Race for the ride you feel through your hands
하중이 실리는 뒷바퀴는 로쪼로 보호와 내구성을: In the rear, where the load sits, Rozzo for protection and durability
Ultradynamico가 타이어와 완벽하게 짝을 이루도록 디자인한 첫: The first rim designed by Ultradynamico to pair perfectly with its tires. A classics-inspired carbon rim for rim brakes, tubeless compatible and hooked, with a 25mm internal width and 18mm depth. At home from road to rugged dirt. Arriving in spring 2027 in 700C.
사이즈별 무게(레이스 케이싱)와 권장 공기압(튜블리스): Weight (Race casing) and recommended pressure (tubeless) by size

Tires made
by two friends
fussy about tires.
큰 계획은 없었습니다. 세상에 없던 타이어 하나를 만들고 싶었고, 아무도: There was no grand plan. They wanted to make one tire that didn't exist, and figured that even if no one bought it, the two of them could use it for life. That small company now makes four treads in four casings, across more than thirty specs.
론과 팻이 텍사스 오스틴에서 로드 레이싱 팀 울리 매머드를 함께 만듭니다: Ron and Pat co-found the road racing team Wooly Mammoth in Austin, Texas. A long friendship between two tire snobs begins.
세상에 없던 타이어를 직접 만들기로 합니다. 오래 잊고 있던 주식을 정리: They decide to make a tire that doesn't exist. Selling some long-forgotten stock becomes the startup fund.
첫 타이어 로제가 세상에 나옵니다. 그해 봄 캔자스의 그래블 레이스 더티: The first tire, Rosé, arrives. That spring, Ultradynamico tires are first spotted at the Dirty Kanza gravel race in Kansas.
매끈한 카바와 ATB용 마르스가 더해집니다. 26인치까지 갖춰 클래식 M: The smooth Cava and the ATB Mars join the range. With 26 inch sizes, they win over classic MTB riders too.
카바와 로제 사이의 브뤼, 저압에 강한 로쪼 케이싱이 합류하며 네 가지: Brut, between Cava and Rosé, and the low-pressure Rozzo casing join, completing sixteen tires from four treads and four casings.
타이어와 짝을 이루는 첫 카본 림 콩테가 2027년 봄 출시를 앞두고 있: Comté, the first carbon rim made to pair with the tires, is set to arrive in spring 2027.
론이 디자인한 파츠를 선보이는 곳: Where Ron's other parts are released
케이싱의 유연함은 손으로 만져봐야 압니다. 루비워크샵에서 Ultradyn: You have to touch a casing to feel how supple it is. At Rubi Workshop you can see Ultradynamico tires in person, and we will help you choose the tread, casing and size for your bike, rims and riding style. We can also advise on fitting and tubeless setup.
